lines.zh: 我一跳，地上就留一小滩绿。
lines.en: Each hop leaves a little green puddle.

lines.zh: 我滚过去，草都蔫了。
lines.en: I roll past and the grass wilts behind me.

lines.zh: 黏液拖在身后，像一条湿路。
lines.en: Slime trails behind me like a wet road.

lines.zh: 我跳得不高，但落地很响。
lines.en: I don't hop high, but I land loud.

lines.zh: 毒料堆的泥，比我还软。
lines.en: The Toxic Heap mud is softer than I am.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，地面冒泡。
lines.en: I slide along and the ground bubbles.

lines.zh: 你听见咕嘟声，那就是我在走。
lines.en: That gurgling sound is me, walking.

lines.zh: 我的身体太沉，跳一次歇一会。
lines.en: I'm too heavy; one hop, then a rest.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，虫子都躲开了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the bugs get out of the way.

lines.zh: 我滑行比跳跃省力。
lines.en: Sliding costs me less than hopping.

lines.zh: 绿色的水痕，跟着我一路。
lines.en: A green waterline follows me the whole way.

lines.zh: 我踩着泡沫走，脚感很软。
lines.en: I walk on foam; the footing is soft.

lines.zh: 别跟太近，我走过会留毒。
lines.en: Don't follow close; my path stays toxic.

lines.zh: 我往低处滚，那里积着脏水。
lines.en: I roll downhill, where the dirty water pools.

lines.zh: 我一跳，泡沫就炸开一圈。
lines.en: One hop and a ring of foam bursts open.

lines.zh: 毒料堆的酸水被我搅浑。
lines.en: I stir the sour water of the Toxic Heap.

lines.zh: 我慢慢鼓起来，又慢慢瘪下去。
lines.en: I swell slowly, then slowly sink.

lines.zh: 我身上的泡，一个接一个破。
lines.en: The bubbles on me pop one after another.

lines.zh: 毒料堆的雾，今天特别浓。
lines.en: The Toxic Heap haze is thick today.

lines.zh: 我把一小块自己挤出来，又吸回去。
lines.en: I squeeze out a bit of myself and pull it back.

lines.zh: 我在数头顶的气泡，数不清。
lines.en: I count the bubbles overhead and lose count.

lines.zh: 我的颜色越深，毒性越强。
lines.en: The deeper my color, the stronger the poison.

lines.zh: 泥里埋着骨头，我不去碰。
lines.en: Bones lie in the mud; I leave them be.

lines.zh: 我静静地渗水，像块湿海绵。
lines.en: I seep quietly, like a soaked sponge.

lines.zh: 有只苍蝇落在我身上，不动了。
lines.en: A fly lands on me and stops moving.

lines.zh: 我在等雨，雨会让毒散开。
lines.en: I wait for rain; rain spreads the poison.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁，凉一点舒服。
lines.en: I press against the rock wall where it's cooler.

lines.zh: 谁在我身上刻了个记号？
lines.en: Who carved a mark into my body?

lines.zh: 你离我不到一格半。
lines.en: You're less than a block and a half away.

lines.zh: 你的面罩呢？我看看。
lines.en: Where's your mask? Let me see.

lines.zh: 你屏住呼吸，可皮肤也会吸。
lines.en: You hold your breath, but skin breathes too.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，绿的那种盯。
lines.en: I've got my eye on you. The green kind.

lines.zh: 你靴子上沾了我的黏液。
lines.en: My slime is on your boots already.

lines.zh: 走过来一点，就一点点。
lines.en: Come a little closer. Just a little.

lines.zh: 我身上有股甜味，你闻到了吧。
lines.en: There's a sweet smell on me; you noticed.

lines.zh: 你脸色开始发绿了，很好。
lines.en: Your face is turning green; good.

lines.zh: 毒料堆欢迎新客人。
lines.en: The Toxic Heap welcomes new guests.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你站着就会中招。
lines.en: I needn't chase; standing there is enough.

lines.zh: 你砍下去，我又长回来一点。
lines.en: You cut, and I grow a little of it back.

lines.zh: 我的边角掉了一块，不疼。
lines.en: A piece of my edge fell off; no pain.

lines.zh: 别用剑，溅出来更难收拾。
lines.en: Put the sword away; the splash is worse.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，又弹回原样。
lines.en: I shrink, then bounce back to my shape.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打散成两团。
lines.en: That blow split me into two blobs.

lines.zh: 我流了一点，地上更绿了。
lines.en: I leaked a little; the ground is greener.

lines.zh: 你力气挺大，可惜我软。
lines.en: You hit hard; too bad I'm soft.

lines.zh: 我的泡被打破了几个。
lines.en: A few of my bubbles burst.

lines.zh: 疼是没有的，黏是有的。
lines.en: There's no pain, only stickiness.

lines.zh: 你再打，我就溅你一身。
lines.en: Hit me again and I'll splash you.

lines.zh: 你身上那股腐叶味，真香。
lines.en: That rotten-leaf smell on you is lovely.

lines.zh: 有湿的东西，我就想贴上去。
lines.en: Anything damp, I want to press against.

lines.zh: 你背包里是不是有蘑菇？
lines.en: Is there a mushroom in your pack?

lines.zh: 一桶脏水，我能高兴一整天。
lines.en: A bucket of dirty water makes my whole day.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那只虫子，味道飘过来了。
lines.en: The bug you crushed; its scent drifts over.

lines.zh: 我闻到了堆肥，就在你脚边。
lines.en: I smell compost, right by your feet.

lines.zh: 你手里的烂苹果，给我吧。
lines.en: That rotten apple in your hand, give it here.

lines.zh: 湿泥巴的味道，比什么都好。
lines.en: Wet mud smells better than anything else.

lines.zh: 你身上有雨的味道，跟我走。
lines.en: You carry the smell of rain; come along.

lines.zh: 让我舔一口你的靴子，就一口。
lines.en: Let me lick your boot. Just once.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，黏液就沾上你了。
lines.en: You bumped me, so now the slime is yours.

lines.zh: 我一弹，你被黏在原地。
lines.en: I bounce and you stick where you stand.

lines.zh: 别推，我这一身会溅开。
lines.en: Don't shove; this body splatters.

lines.zh: 你踩进我留的水洼里了。
lines.en: You stepped into the puddle I left.

lines.zh: 我软，可我不让路。
lines.en: I'm soft, but I don't give way.

lines.zh: 撞一下，你手上就起了疹子。
lines.en: One bump and a rash starts on your hand.

lines.zh: 我们黏在一起了，你得拽开。
lines.en: We're stuck together; you'll have to pull free.

lines.zh: 我的表面在你袖口留下一圈绿。
lines.en: My surface leaves a green ring on your cuff.

lines.zh: 你退后，黏液会拉成丝。
lines.en: Step back and the slime stretches into threads.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，毒性可没轻。
lines.en: The bump was light; the poison wasn't.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走，这样最省力。
lines.en: I move pressed against you; it's less effort.

lines.zh: 你把我的边角撞掉了一小块。
lines.en: You knocked a small piece off my edge.

lines.zh: 这块地归我，你绕一下。
lines.en: This patch is mine; go around.

lines.zh: 别用剑戳，会溅你一脸。
lines.en: Don't poke me with that sword; it splashes.

lines.zh: 两团黏液靠近，会并成一团。
lines.en: Two blobs of slime merge into one.

lines.zh: 我分出一小块，送给你养。
lines.en: I split off a small piece for you to keep.

lines.zh: 同色的一起跳，节奏就齐了。
lines.en: Same-colored ones hop in the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 你能陪我在泥里待一会吗。
lines.en: Would you sit in the mud with me a while?

lines.zh: 我们合过一次，又分开了。
lines.en: We merged once, then came apart again.

lines.zh: 我这一团，缺的那角是你。
lines.en: This blob of mine is missing a corner: you.

lines.zh: 一起冒泡，比独自冒泡有趣。
lines.en: Bubbling together beats bubbling alone.

lines.zh: 我把最干净的一块分给你。
lines.en: I'll share my cleanest part with you.

lines.zh: 你若化了，我就把你吸回来。
lines.en: If you melt, I'll draw you back in.

lines.zh: 两团绿贴在一起，看不出谁是谁。
lines.en: Two greens pressed close; no telling which is which.

lines.zh: 我裹住那块腐肉，慢慢化掉。
lines.en: I wrap the rotten flesh and let it dissolve.

lines.zh: 地上的蘑菇，我顺手卷进来。
lines.en: The mushroom on the ground rolls into me.

lines.zh: 我用身体把东西整个包住。
lines.en: I swallow things whole with my body.

lines.zh: 这根骨头太硬，我吐出来了。
lines.en: That bone was too hard; I spat it out.

lines.zh: 铁锭我吞不下，卡在边上。
lines.en: An iron ingot won't go down; it sticks at my edge.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块苔藓，颜色好看。
lines.en: I pick up moss; the color pleases me.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西，我也捞。
lines.en: Things dropped in water get fished out too.

lines.zh: 我把碎玻璃裹起来，免得割人。
lines.en: I wrap the broken glass so it won't cut anyone.

lines.zh: 这粒种子在我肚子里发芽了。
lines.en: This seed sprouted inside me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，东西跑不掉。
lines.en: I slide over slowly; the thing can't get away.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的水洼。
lines.en: You stepped in my puddle and ruined it.

lines.zh: 你身上没有那层防毒的衣服。
lines.en: You're missing that poison-proof suit.

lines.zh: 你走近了，这就够了。
lines.en: You came close; that's all I needed.

lines.zh: 我闻到你的汗，很新鲜。
lines.en: I smell your sweat; it's fresh.

lines.zh: 有人往我身上扔石头，是你？
lines.en: Someone threw a stone at me. You?

lines.zh: 你在我地盘上站了太久。
lines.en: You've stood on my ground too long.

lines.zh: 我慢慢来，你别急着跑。
lines.en: I'll take my time; don't rush off.

lines.zh: 那块苔藓是我的，你踩了。
lines.en: That moss was mine, and you stepped on it.

lines.zh: 你手上有个伤口，正好。
lines.en: There's a cut on your hand. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我决定跟着你了。
lines.en: I've decided to follow you.

lines.zh: 你跑到上风处，也没用。
lines.en: Running upwind won't help you.

lines.zh: 我滚得慢，可我的味散得快。
lines.en: I roll slowly, but my stench spreads fast.

lines.zh: 你捂住口鼻，眼睛还露着。
lines.en: Cover your mouth and nose; your eyes still show.

lines.zh: 我跳过石头，追着你的脚印。
lines.en: I hop the rocks, following your prints.

lines.zh: 你越跑，汗越多，越好找。
lines.en: The more you run, the more you sweat to track.

lines.zh: 我留下一路绿水，你回头看看。
lines.en: I leave a green trail; look behind you.

lines.zh: 别躲进洞里，那里闷。
lines.en: Don't hide in a cave; the air sits still there.

lines.zh: 我撞开灌木，叶子都枯了。
lines.en: I push through bushes and the leaves wither.

lines.zh: 你的速度撑不了多久。
lines.en: Your pace won't last much longer.

lines.zh: 我在你后面三格，一直跟着。
lines.en: I'm three blocks behind, and I keep coming.

lines.zh: 我整个扑上去，把你裹住。
lines.en: I lunge and wrap myself around you.

lines.zh: 这一掌不痛，毒才叫你痛。
lines.en: The slap is nothing; the poison is the point.

lines.zh: 我弹起来，砸在你膝盖上。
lines.en: I bounce up and land on your knee.

lines.zh: 你被黏住，动作就慢了。
lines.en: Once stuck, your movements slow down.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍过去，留下一片绿。
lines.en: One slap from me leaves a green smear.

lines.zh: 你挡得住我，挡不住我的味。
lines.en: You can block me, not my fumes.

lines.zh: 我把自己压扁，铺在你脚下。
lines.en: I flatten myself under your feet.

lines.zh: 这一撞，够你晕一会。
lines.en: This impact will keep you dizzy a while.

lines.zh: 我的拳头就是一团黏。
lines.en: My fist is just a lump of goo.

lines.zh: 你咳起来了，节奏不错。
lines.en: You're coughing now; nice rhythm.

lines.zh: 毒料堆的泥里，我慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: I swell up slowly out of the Toxic Heap mud.

lines.zh: 一场绿雨过后，我就出现了。
lines.en: After a green rain, there I am.

lines.zh: 我从水洼里挤出来，带着泡。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the puddle, bubbling.

lines.zh: 地面先冒泡，然后才有我。
lines.en: The ground bubbles first; then comes me.

lines.zh: 这地方的空气，本来就有毒。
lines.en: The air here was already poisonous.

lines.zh: 我睁开一只眼，看见一片绿雾。
lines.en: I open one eye onto a green haze.

lines.zh: 泥里的东西一起醒了。
lines.en: Everything in the mud woke at once.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，压出一个坑。
lines.en: I land and press out a crater.

lines.zh: 谁把废料倒在这里，谢谢他。
lines.en: Whoever dumped the waste here, thank you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢聚成形，先有泡，再有我。
lines.en: I gather into shape: bubbles first, then me.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的表面就结皮。
lines.en: Fire bakes a skin over my surface.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，我摊成一张饼。
lines.en: I hit the ground and spread into a pancake.

lines.zh: 泡在水里，我越胀越大。
lines.en: Soaking in water, I swell bigger and bigger.

lines.zh: 炸得我分成三团，各自还在动。
lines.en: The blast split me into three, each still moving.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个小洞。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and leaves a small hole.

lines.zh: 魔法把我定住，黏液还在流。
lines.en: Magic holds me still while the slime keeps flowing.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，颜色会变淡。
lines.en: When I'm hungry, my color fades.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我身上亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my body flashed bright.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥，我快干了。
lines.en: No mud in the void; I'm drying out.
